caption: The drawing contains five labeled views of a pocket watch. In the center top section, there is a detailed color illustration of the inner mechanical workings of the watch, featuring gold and yellow components with engraved text and intricate gears. Directly below this, a full-color illustration of the watch face is depicted, showing a white dial with black Roman numerals, black minute marks, and two black hands, with an additional small seconds subdial; the watch case is outlined in gold. On the left, there are two black-and-white outline drawings: one is a side profile of the watch labeled "SIDE," and the other is the back view with its cover open, labeled "BACK," both marked "EXACT SIZE." On the right, another black-and-white outline shows the front with its cover open, labeled "FRONT EXACT SIZE." All views are arranged on a plain, uncolored background and are rendered with precise lines and clear labeling.
title: Gold Watch and Frame
